韩小汐有些克制不住地勾上了男人的脖子。

放纵自己沉浸在男人激烈的索取中。

她甚至感受到了他的一丝失控。

一点也不绅士，甚至有些霸道……

但，她抱他更紧了。

她喜欢为自己失控的他。

然而她没注意到自己更加失控。

整个人毫不设防地偎在男人怀里，呼吸越来越重。

除了一条由山底直通山腰的电缆车，这里的房子里连电都没有通，就连那辆电缆车，使用权限也受到了严格的控制。

而正是这东西，引动他的五行空间，绝对是了不得宝贝，这还是他的五行空间第一次闹腾的这么欢。

“我徒弟信任你，我这个当师尊的，也相信我徒弟的眼光。”柳城认真道。

Han Xiaoxi couldn't help but hooked her arms around the man's neck.

Indulge yourself in the man's intense demands.

She even felt a little out of control on his part.

Not a gentleman at all, even a little domineering...

But, she hugged him tighter.

She likes him losing control of himself.

However, she didn't notice that she was even more out of control.

She snuggled into the man's arms without any defense, breathing heavier and heavier.

Except for a cable car that runs from the bottom of the mountain to the mountainside, there is no electricity in the houses here. Even the cable car's use rights are strictly controlled.

And it is this thing that triggers his Five Elements Space, which is definitely a treasure. This is the first time that his Five Elements Space has been so noisy.

"My apprentice trusts you. As a master, I also believe in my apprentice's vision." Liucheng said seriously.
